comment: Spec 055 §9.3 chaos list for TS-1D (unit 055-t17): every case names the test that runs it. `real_process` cases run in scripts/tests/test_node_wire_chaos.py (packed tarball, real Node processes, one shared spool, the reader); the others are the unit tests that already inject the fault at the exact system call (sdk/typescript/test/wire/..., `file::title`). Worker-thread and core-HTTP cases are deferred to their units and not claimed.
